rationale: The failure occurred because we landed on the Moncler homepage where no PLP tiles exist and likely hit a cookie/locale gate. The safest fix is to normalize directly to a stable PLP under the en-gb locale and ensure cookie consent is accepted. Added resilient PLP/PDP fallback selectors aligned with common Moncler markup (ProductGrid containers, product cards, itemprop-based title/price). URL rules prevent locale drift (e.g., /en-jp) and accidental monclergroup.com redirects. Minimal overrides add wait/click steps for OneTrust consent and basic lazy-load handling without changing core logic.
code_hints: If landing on the homepage or locale gate, immediately click #onetrust-accept-btn-handler if present, then navigate to the PLP URL defined in start_url.

After navigation, wait for the PLP container selector (section[data-component*='ProductGrid'], [data-component='product-grid'], .product-grid, ul[class*='product-grid']) and ensure at least plp_min_items product cards are present before extraction.
Extract PDP links from within each product card using the pdp_link_alt selector; de-duplicate and keep only URLs under /en-gb/.
On PDP, read title via h1[itemprop='name'] fallback chain and price via [itemprop='price'] fallback chain; prefer data attributes if available.
If PLP container is not found but header is visible, retry by reloading the normalized PLP URL and performing a gentle scroll (2 passes) to trigger lazy loading.
Set Accept-Language header to en-GB and avoid following any redirects that change locale away from /en-gb/.
